## e971e0773705

No issue found after checking the generator's 28 `scene_code` profiles, exact-T component validator, public-profile embeddings, and capped-count profiles. In particular, it includes `top_cap=(5,2)`, `bottom_cap=(2,5)`, and `both_cap=(5,5)`, so the fixed four-position output is not teachable as an uncapped count. Its public inputs are retained (with padding/reflection variants), and generalized inputs preserve isolated exact top-bar and bottom-bar T tetrominoes. The apparent shortcut “classify by how many cells lie in the component's topmost row” is the selected rule's own orientation test on this exact-T domain, not a competing rule.
